options.name: post_reboot_delay
options.description: Seconds to wait for validation after reboot command was successful

options.name: pre_reboot_delay
options.description: Seconds to wait before reboot. Passed as a parameter to the reboot command.

options.name: reboot_timeout
options.description: Maximum seconds to wait for machine to reboot and respond to a test command.

options.name: test_command
options.description: Command to run on the rebooted host to validate system running status.
